Confirmed scope for Minecraft Education pilot

Dear Chris,

We completed our internal discussion and can now confirm a limited first pilot.

Confirmed pilot decisions

TopicConfirmed status
School adviserJames Stone will coordinate the pilot for the school.
Initial scopeThe first pilot is after-school only. Classroom integration is postponed until the pilot has been evaluated.
Concept workshopConfirmed for 12 September 2024 at 13:00.
Team trainingStarts on 26 September 2024, not on 19 September as initially proposed.
CapacityThe pilot is limited to 16 students, rather than the initial estimate of 20.
External competitionNo external competition is approved at this stage. A later decision will depend on the internal pilot evaluation.

Learning focus

The pilot should focus on coding, teamwork and collaborative problem solving. Citizenship and sustainability may be used as challenge themes, but they are not mandatory learning objectives for the first pilot.

Internal planning note — restricted to project leads

For internal budgeting only, the initial pilot has a provisional cost ceiling of EUR 3,200. This amount is not intended for general participant communications. A public-facing description may state only that the pilot has an approved internal budget.

Please prepare a short concept draft for the workshop on 12 September.
